<a id="page-theme"></a>
# Theme and text

<a id="theme-when-to-use"></a>
## When to use

A site's palette and type scale, declared once and named everywhere; dark mode and a type scale that changes with
the screen size; and the `text` node in depth (runs, links, superscripts, fonts, text direction).

<a id="theme-minimal-example"></a>
## Minimal example

A site manifest (`site.json`) with a theme: a palette and a type scale. The page next to it names them.

```json
{
  "schema": 3,
  "pages": ["home.json"],
  "theme": {
    "colors": {"ink": "#FF1B1B1B", "ember": "#FFE4572E", "paper": "#FFF6F1E9"},
    "textStyles": {
      "body": {"fontSize": 16, "height": 1.5, "color": "ink"},
      "title": {"from": "body", "fontSize": 32, "fontWeight": 700, "height": 1.2},
      "eyebrow": {"from": "body", "fontSize": 12, "letterSpacing": 2, "color": "ember"}
    },
    "media": [{"minWidth": 1024, "patch": {"textStyles": {"title": {"fontSize": 56}}}}]
  }
}
```

A page using it (a fragment of `home.json`'s `nodes`):

```json
"eyebrow": {"type": "text", "props": {"text": "OUR MENU", "style": "eyebrow"}, "layout": {"width": {"fill": 342}, "height": {"hug": 18}}},
"title":   {"type": "text", "props": {"text": "Fire, smoke and season", "style": "title"}, "layout": {"width": {"fill": 342}, "height": {"hug": 40}}},
"note":    {"type": "text", "props": {"text": "Cooked over oak.", "style": {"from": "body", "color": "ember"}}, "layout": {"width": {"fill": 342}, "height": {"hug": 24}}},
"rule":    {"type": "box", "layout": {"width": 120, "height": 4}, "decoration": {"fills": [{"color": "ember"}]}}
```

<a id="theme-reference"></a>
## Reference

<a id="theme-theme-keys"></a>
### Theme keys

The theme (`site.json`'s `theme`, or the app's theme at run time):

| Key | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `colors` | Every named color of the project by key (`themeKey` of its name: "Brand Blue" is `brandBlue`), read as `${theme.colors.brandBlue}`. |
| `textStyles` | Every named text style by key, read as `${theme.text.title.fontSize}` and named by a text's style (`"style": "title"`, or `{"from": "title", ...}` to change some of its fields). A style may itself start `from` another and name `colors`; `textStyle` gives it resolved. |
| `dark` | The colors for dark mode: the tokens and `colors` that differ from the light ones (its other fields are not used). |
| `media` | The theme by screen size, as CSS media queries over custom properties: each rule's `patch` is a theme's JSON (`{"textStyles": {"display": {"fontSize": 40}}, "colors": {...}}`) merged over this one while the screen meets its conditions (`atScreen`). A type scale that changes at a breakpoint is written once here, not on every text. |
| `primary` | Primary buttons and info toasts. |
| `onPrimary` | Text on `primary`. |
| `surface` | Dialog backgrounds. |
| `onSurface` | Text on `surface`. |
| `error` | Destructive buttons and error toasts. |
| `success` | Success toasts. |
| `warning` | Warning toasts. |
| `fontFamily` | Font family of body text and buttons. |
| `titleFontFamily` | Font family of titles. |
| `radius` | Corner radius of dialogs. |
| `buttonRadius` | Corner radius of buttons. |
| `naturalLineHeight` | Whether text without a line height takes its font's own (Flutter's default) rather than the SDK's 1.33 (`StyleSheet.naturalLineHeight`). |

<a id="node-text"></a>
### `text`

Flutter `Text.rich`.

`Text.rich`: a string with styled runs.

- Children: none.
- Decoration: none: only blur effects in `decoration.effects` apply.

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `text` | String | `""` |  | The text shown. May hold expressions: `"Hello, ${user.name}"`. |
| `style` | [TextStyle](theme.md#type-TextStyle) | `{}` |  | Base style for the whole text. |
| `runs` | List<[TextRun](theme.md#type-TextRun)> | `[]` |  | Styled ranges over `text`, merged over `style`. |
| `textAlign` | [TextAlign](values.md#enum-TextAlign) | `"start"` | `left`, `right`, `center`, `justify`, `start`, `end` | How lines are aligned inside the node's width (Flutter's `TextAlign`). |
| `textAlignVertical` | [TextAlignVertical](values.md#enum-TextAlignVertical) | `"top"` | `top`, `center`, `bottom` | Where the lines sit when the node is taller than they are. |
| `maxLines` | int | unset |  | At most this many lines; the rest is cut as `overflow` says. Null: no limit. |
| `overflow` | [TextOverflow](values.md#enum-TextOverflow) | `"clip"` | `clip`, `fade`, `ellipsis`, `visible` | What shows where the text is cut by `maxLines` or the node's size (Flutter's `TextOverflow`): `clip`, `fade`, `ellipsis`, `visible`. |
| `selectable` | bool | `false` |  | The user can select and copy the text (Flutter's `SelectableText`). |
| `scaleDown` | bool | `false` |  | Shrinks the whole text to fit its width, keeping its lines (`FittedBox(fit: BoxFit.scaleDown)`). |
| `countUp` | bool | `false` |  | A number in the text (after binding: "1,204", "\$12.50", "87%") counts up to each new value in a running app, from the value on screen; the characters around it, its decimals and its thousands separators stay. A design canvas (or TickerMode off) shows the final text. |
| `countUpDuration` | int | `500` | ≥ 0 | Milliseconds of one count. |
| `countUpCurve` | [AnimationCurve](values.md#enum-AnimationCurve) | `"linear"` |  | The curve a number in the text counts up along when it changes. |
| `countUpOnShow` | bool | `true` |  | The first value counts up from 0 when the text first shows; off, it shows at rest and only later changes count. |

<a id="behavior-textDirection"></a>
### `textDirection` (behavior)

A node key (beside `layout` and `props`). Type: [TextDirection](values.md#enum-TextDirection). Default: unset. Allowed: `ltr`, `rtl`.

Null inherits.

<a id="type-TextStyle"></a>
### TextStyle

Flutter's `TextStyle`. Every field is optional: a span's style is merged over its text's base style, as in `Text.rich`.

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `from` | String | unset |  | The name of one of the project's text styles (the site manifest's `theme.textStyles`) this style starts from, as `Theme.of(context).textTheme.titleLarge.merge(...)`: the fields written here change it. `"style": "title"` is short for `{"from": "title"}`. |
| `fontFamily` | String | unset |  | The font family (`"Inter"`); `fontWeight` picks its file. Without one: the platform's default (Roboto). |
| `fontWeight` | [FontWeight](values.md#type-FontWeight) | unset |  | Flutter's `FontWeight`: 100–900, in hundreds. |
| `fontStyle` | [FontStyle](values.md#enum-FontStyle) | unset | `normal`, `italic` | `normal` or `italic`. |
| `fontSize` | double | unset | ≥ 0 | The font size in logical pixels. Without one: 12. |
| `color` | [Color](values.md#type-Color) | unset |  | Solid text color. |
| `foreground` | [Paint](decoration.md#type-Paint) | unset |  | A gradient or image paint for the glyphs, used instead of `color`. |
| `letterSpacing` | double | unset |  | Logical pixels between letters. |
| `height` | double | unset | ≥ 0 | Line height, as a multiple of the font size. |
| `decoration` | [TextDecoration](values.md#enum-TextDecoration) | unset | `none`, `underline`, `overline`, `lineThrough` | A line through the text: `underline`, `overline`, `lineThrough` or `none`. |
| `decorationColor` | [Color](values.md#type-Color) | unset |  | The colour of the `decoration` line; without one, the text's colour. |
| `backgroundColor` | [Color](values.md#type-Color) | unset |  | Painted behind the glyphs. |
| `decorationStyle` | [TextDecorationStyle](values.md#enum-TextDecorationStyle) | unset | `solid`, `double`, `dotted`, `dashed`, `wavy` | The `decoration` line's style: `solid`, `double`, `dotted`, `dashed`, `wavy`. |
| `decorationThickness` | double | unset |  | The `decoration` line's thickness, as a multiple of the font's default. |
| `tabularFigures` | bool | unset |  | Fixed-width digits (`OpenTypeFeature.tabularFigures`). |
| `fontFeatures` | List<[FontFeature](values.md#type-FontFeature)> | `[]` |  | OpenType feature settings (`"lnum"`, `"ss01"`, `"liga=0"`). |
| `leadingDistribution` | [TextLeadingDistribution](values.md#enum-TextLeadingDistribution) | unset | `proportional`, `even` | Where a line's extra (or missing) height goes (`TextStyle .leadingDistribution`); null is Flutter's default, proportional. |
| `shadows` | List<[Effect](decoration.md#type-Effect)> | `[]` |  | Text shadows (drop shadows only). |
| `naturalHeight` | bool | unset |  | With no height, the font's own line height instead of the base style's. |

<a id="type-TextRun"></a>
### TextRun

A styled range of a text's characters, `[start, end)`.

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `start` | int | `0` |  |  |
| `end` | int | `0` |  |  |
| `style` | [TextStyle](theme.md#type-TextStyle) | `{}` |  |  |
| `link` | String | unset |  | A URL the run opens when tapped. |

<a id="theme-patterns"></a>
## Patterns

<a id="theme-named-colours-and-styles"></a>
### Named colours and styles

- **Colours**: `colors` maps a name to `"#AARRGGBB"` (or to another colour's name: `"accent": "ember"`). Wherever a
  colour is accepted, write its name. The roles `primary`, `onPrimary`, `surface`, `onSurface`, `error`, `success`,
  `warning` (keys of the theme) are names too.
- **Text styles**: `textStyles` maps a name to a TextStyle. A style may start `from` another and name colours. A
  text names its style in one field, `"style": "title"`; to change some fields of it, `"style": {"from": "title",
  "color": "ember"}` (`textTheme.titleLarge.merge(...)`: the fields written win). Runs, a button's `textStyle` and
  an input's styles take the same two forms.
- Changing a colour or style in the theme changes every node that names it, and only those.
- In a binding a name is not read: bind the value, `"${theme.colors.ember}"` or `"${theme.text.title}"`.

<a id="theme-a-type-scale-that-changes-with-the-screen-size"></a>
### A type scale that changes with the screen size

The theme's `media` rules patch the theme as a node's rules patch a node: `{"minWidth": 1024, "patch":
{"textStyles": {"title": {"fontSize": 56}}}}` makes every text using `title` grow at desktop width, written once. A
node's own media rule may switch its style (`"patch": {"props": {"style": "caption"}}`, which replaces the style)
or change some fields (`{"style": {"fontSize": 20}}`, merged over the named style).

<a id="theme-dark-mode"></a>
### Dark mode

`"dark": {"colors": {"ink": "#FFEEEEEE"}}` gives the colours that differ in dark mode; a node naming `ink` follows
the device's mode. `${theme.isDark}` is true in dark mode.

<a id="theme-text"></a>
### Text

A `text` node has `props.text` and `props.style`. What a text looks like when the style leaves something out: no
`color`, white; no `fontSize`, 12; no `fontWeight`, 400; no `fontFamily`, the platform's default (Roboto on Android
and the web). Sizing: one line `{"hug": n}` × `{"hug": n}`; a paragraph `{"fill": n}` wide × `{"hug": n}` high. A
fixed height shorter than the lines clips them (`text_clipped`).

`runs` style parts of the text: `[{"start": 0, "end": 5, "style": {"fontWeight": 700}}]` (character offsets, end
exclusive, `\n` counting as one), merged over `style`; a run may carry a `"link"` URL. A literal `$` right before an
expression is text: `"$${price}"` shows `$47`. There is no escape for a literal `${`: compute it.

<a id="theme-superscripts-and-a-raised-currency-sign"></a>
### Superscripts and a raised currency sign

A raised or lowered character (a price's "$", a footnote mark): a run with `"fontFeatures": ["sups"]` (or `"subs"`)
when the font has those OpenType features; otherwise a smaller `fontSize` in a row of texts aligned
`crossAxisAlignment: start` (or `baseline`) for the exact shift.

<a id="theme-fonts"></a>
### Fonts

`style.fontFamily` names a family (`"Inter"`), with `fontWeight` choosing the file. An app fetches Google Fonts by
name. The render command uses font files from `--fonts <dir>` plus Roboto, and reports a family it does not have
(`font_fallback`). Characters the font has no glyph for draw as empty boxes (`missing_glyph`): use an `icon`.

<a id="theme-pitfalls"></a>
## Pitfalls

- A text without a colour is white (`text_no_color` when rendered): set it in the style or the named style.
- A name the theme does not have is `unknown_theme_name` (with the nearest name); a theme of the wrong shape is
  `invalid_theme`. Without a `site.json`, put the page in a folder with one: `{"schema": 3, "pages": ["home.json"],
  "theme": {...}}`.
- A theme colour's name is not read from a formula: bind `${theme.colors.ember}`.
- A `text` has no padding (its box is its lines): use `margin`, or a row with padding around it.
- Run offsets count characters, `\n` as one.
